name: Captured-Photobooth
description: It is an offline ready web photobooth. Why pay for ₱200-₱300 ($3.20-$4.79) photobooth when you can have it on your phone on the go for FREE? Capture every moment and save your printable strip, keep every memory captured! Try it now!

paragraphs: A photobooth that runs entirely in the browser. No app, no account, no upload your camera feed never leaves the device, and every strip you keep stays on it.

Captured turns any browser into a photobooth. Pick your frames, shoot them, style the strip, retake only what you hate, and download or share it. Every strip you keep is filed in your own cabinet, on your own device, which is the whole point: a photobooth you can come back to.

The preview uses a CSS filter on , which every browser supports. The download draws the same frame onto a canvas and used to rely on ctx.filter a property older iOS Safari and some Android WebViews silently ignore. The fix is a capability probe plus a colour-matrix fallback, so Mono looks identical in the preview and in the file you save. Details in lib/filters.ts.
